mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 72 degrees with clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park and a third quarter moon. If you are up early, look for the ISS at 4:24 AM as it travels from the Cross Plains area toward the Oregon and Fitchburg direction, passing nearly overhead.

City updates include phase two of the Aldi development road construction beginning the week of September 7, which will shift traffic patterns on Highway M. Additionally, the Military Ridge State Trail will see bridge replacements between Lincoln and South Franklin Street starting in mid-September.

There is plenty to do, including the Dane County Farmers Market today, plus live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness on September 7, trivia at Hop Haus and the Wisconsin Brewing Company on September 8, and the Verona Downtown Farmers Market on September 9.
The Verona Police Department reported that on Sunday, August 30, they were informed of an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and a student from 2019, leading to an arrest this past week.
Culver's has a delicious Mint Cookie flavor of the day ready for you, and the doors open today at 10:00 AM.
